item.text: I’ll trace the config validation and existing tests, write the required checkpoint early, then implement the smallest fix and run the relevant repository tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: validate required GitHub and OIDC authentication configuration fields at startup, including GitHub "'`read:org` when organizations are restricted.

Current status: locating the config validation implementation and existing tests. No source changes made yet.
EOF
find . -name AGENTS.md -print; grep -RIn --include='"'*.go' -E 'allowed_organizations|redirect_address|client_secret|OIDC|oidc' . | head -200"
